instruction: For each garbage movie title, count the number of words (after removing extra whitespace) and put the word count in the corresponding 'Clean Movie Titles' cell. Don't touch irrelevant regions.

metadata.explanation: Task requires counting words in each garbage movie title after trimming extra spaces. Getter reads column C values, metric compares each against expected integer word counts with partial credit per row.
